description: Come join local architects and activists from Peckham Heritage, Peckham Vision and Peckham Society on a walk exploring Peckham's tangible and intangible heritage. Despite a backdrop of insensitive development proposals, decades of tireless community work continue to shape the area. Come explore with us one of London's most critical questions: 'What does it take to build or to destroy a community?'

factsheet.heading: Peckham's tangible and intangible heritage
paragraphs: Discover Peckham Heritage, Peckham Vision and Peckham Society's work on a walk exploring Peckham's tangible and intangible heritage. Get a sense of our neighbourhood's character through a walk and sketching workshop with locals, and hear about our campaigns against insensitive overdevelopment. We're inviting both locals and built environment enthusiasts to explore one of London's most critical questions: 'What does it take to build or to destroy a community?'
